PNG filter type must be in 0..4 for filter method 0

notes: This lab validates deterministic APNG partial frame data where the PNG image stream uses Adam7 interlace method 1.
It covers a non-zero 6x6 patch offset so every Adam7 pass is non-empty for the second frame.
It does not claim full APNG/PNG conformance, live editor preservation, or final production carrier selection.
next_research_step: Keep remaining APNG/PNG work scoped to explicit image-data fixtures, live external editor preservation, or final carrier selection evidence before claiming full conformance.
